title: 2026 midterms could be the most expensive on record. And, Macron condemns protests
description: More than $15 billion has been raised in this year's midterm elections. And, France's president is condemning the violent protests erupting across the country.

title: Rep. Don Beyer, D-Va., on Trump waiving sanctions on Russia
description: NPR's Leila Fadel asks Democratic Rep. Don Beyer of Virginia  about President Trump's decision to waive new sanctions on Russia.

title: The real reason it's going to take a while to know who won in some midterm races
description: Hint: It's not only because California counts slowly.

title: Michigan's Democratic Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed campaigns in GOP stronghold
description: Michigan's Democratic U.S. Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed is campaigning in the GOP stronghold of Michigan's Upper Peninsula, an area that hasn't voted for a Democrat in Congress in over a decade.

title: What does a White House press secretary do?
description: Katie Zacharia's short time as White House press secretary has brought renewed attention to the high-profile role.

title: Congress reacts to executive order exempting Russia from economic sanctions
description: NPR's Eric McDaniel reports on how Congress has reacted to President Trump's executive order exempting Russia from economic sanctions.

title: Greensboro, NC students protest the absence of early voting sites on campus
description: NPR's Ayesha Rascoe talks to North Carolina A&T student Shia Rozier about disappointment with early voting sites in Greensboro.

title: What role does the White House Press Secretary play in the Trump era?
description: NPR's Ayesha Rascoe asks Adm. John Kirby, who had spokesperson roles in the Obama and Biden administrations, about the utility of the role of the White House Press Secretary.

title: Politics chat: Zelenskyy on Trump, Democrats bring in the money for midterms
description: From Russia to AI to Iran, President Trump has taken political stances that put him at odds with much of the electorate.

title: Trump defers federal diesel taxes to help farmers, but states issue warnings
description: President Trump's executive order deferring federal taxes on diesel is aimed at helping farmers but it's more complicated than it sounds and states are warning drivers they may owe taxes later.
